name: Wasabi Izuno
source:
Wasabi Izuno is a kunoichi of Konohagakure. Wasabi has short, spiky brown hair and green, cat-like eyes. Wasabi excels in fūinjutsu, able to employ a variety of cat-like traits from her scroll. She can alternatively use this fūinjutsu to restrict a person's movements. She is also considered among the two fastest shinobi in her Academy class. Wasabi is a direct person who is not afraid to speak her mind, she is motivated and hyperactive. She is a member of Team 15.

[In game description]
